purpose: Reduce missed concerns and unnecessary review before stable promotion
first_experiment: Train a direct review-decision head on frozen adapted features, rather than deriving every review from a Cartesian product of uncertain attribute sets.
selection: Train only on existing training rows; choose regularization and per-language review cutoffs on development. Require at least 99 percent review recall in both formal and conversational development groups before minimizing worst-group benign review rate.
existing_tests: All previously inspected v8 controlled and prose cases are regressions, not fresh validation.
promotion_target: At least 99 percent concern review recall and at most 5 percent benign review rate in each language on declared evaluation sets, with no loss on explicit serious-concern regressions; separate unseen evaluation before a stable accuracy claim.
limits: Synthetic results cannot establish zero errors, authentic-child accuracy, or independent language quality. Stable/latest status is conditional on evidence, not a version-label edit.
